text:
Tess: Quick Q — we're thinking of adding an optional "model_info" object to the /v1/generate JSON response to surface variant metadata (quantization, chip_hint). Is that safe for clients that don't set Accept-Model? Will this be considered a breaking change for SDKs or strict parsers?

Alex: Additive optional fields are non-breaking by our compatibility policy, so technically ok. Caveat: some clients (esp older mobile SDKs or strict json schema validators) may reject unknown top-level fields. If we can't guarantee client behaviour, consider a feature flag or header opt-in.

Jamal: Minimal ask: can we ship as optional top-level object and not bump the contract version? Also need a short rollout plan for SDKs + docs + changelog.

Maria: Observability note: if we expose model_info we should also tag traces and metrics with model.version/variant so we can correlate quality regressions during rollout. Without that we won't be able to roll back quickly.

Kevin: Proposed rollout (suggested):
- Stage 1 (canary): 10% traffic for 48h with full telemetry and smoke checks.
- Stage 2: 50% for 1 week, watch quality deltas.
- Stage 3: 100% with a 6-week deprecation window for older SDK behaviour (so customers have time to upgrade).

Tess: One more thing — streaming responses. We plan to append model_info in the final JSON payload after the stream completes. Streaming clients that consume chunks and then parse final JSON might be fine, but some clients expect only text events. Any guidance?

Alex: For streaming, safer to put minimal metadata in a header or a final special event. Options:
1) include model_info in final JSON chunk (documented as optional)
2) add an X-Model-Meta response header for non-streaming and include a final meta event for streams
Either way, document behavior clearly. Example (non-streaming):

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" -H "Accept-Model: redwood:v2" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# Expected final JSON:
{
  "id": "gen_123",
  "output": "hello",
  "model_info": {"name": "redwood", "variant": "quant4x", "seq_len": "4096"}
}
```

Jamal: If we rely on X-Model-Meta header for streams, confirm gateways/proxies (CloudFront, Fastly) won't strip it. Otherwise SDKs will need to read the trailing JSON.

Maria: Also +1 on a console feature toggle for privacy-sensitive customers to opt out of model_info exposure. Need product signoff.

Kevin: We'll wire a toggle. Action items: Alex -> draft API doc and compatibility note; Jamal -> patch SDKs to accept optional model_info (non-breaking); Infra -> add trace tag for model.version; Tess -> coordinate canary. Target dates: draft by Mon (4310000200), canary next Wed (4310000600).

Alex: I'll open the PR with docs + compatibility rationale today.

Jamal: Working on SDK compatibility changes, ETA Wed.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: inference-service:v2 -> 10% @ 4310000600 (auto-canary).

Tess: Thanks all :pray: Keep async updates here and ping if you hit blockers.
